usedFor: TinyURL creates short links and HubSpot holds deals, so “New Tiny URL” can fill a field through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tiny URL” in TinyURL, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A fresh short link can be written onto the deal that uses it.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, and “New Tiny URL” is polling, so the link arrives after a scheduled check.
